sections.title: Lagging sides
lines: No bucket is lagging right now (rule: more than 15% of the leader, up to 150 contracts, behind it, and fair above 5%).
The bot checks every 45s. The moneyline is rechecked every 5m (every 1m in the last 3 hours). Rows already resting are not repriced when the line moves; only new rows use the fresh fair.
A step is skipped if filling the new row in full would push the worst line lower.

sections.title: Next wave of contracts
lines: Extra batches: a bucket whose resting falls under 25% of its allotment gets a batch of 50% of it (a third inside T-30), split 60/25/15 across three prices, up to 3 batches, 20 min apart, until T-3.
The worst-line gate is open ($0 is at or better than -$100).

sections.title: Tightening
lines: Trickle balancing starts at T-120 (Sat 10/17 7:55 PM CT, in 2d 10h): the bot records the worst line then and walks it to -$150 by the fight, selling small clips (50 contracts) at the bid, checking every 5 min, paying only when more than $25 behind, at most $100 paid per book.

From T-30: queue-preserving even-up (a bucket 15% behind the leader gets its lowest rung moved toward fair without losing queue). From T-5: a last-resort take is allowed; it is the old one-shot balancer and spends at most half the banked margin.
Between T-120 and T-30 the evenness allowance tightens on a time schedule, because a fight can end in seconds.
The fight start is an estimate from the card position on ESPN; if earlier bouts run long it moves, and every T- time here moves with it.

sections.title: Will it adapt on its own?
lines: Yes, on its own: the full ladder at the release time, extra batches on thin buckets while the gate is open, price steps on lagging buckets, and the paid trickle from T-120.
No, it will not: reprice resting rows when the moneyline moves, or add anything once the worst line is under the gate. The start time can shift if earlier bouts run long.
I only read the bot's settings, state and log. I cannot see its next decision, only the rules it follows.
